title: How much knowledge comes through media
statement: How much of a reading course's knowledge building should come through other media rather than through reading is undecided.
example: One suggestion in a build meeting put the share of content knowledge building that relies on multiple media at maybe 30% or 40%.
detail: In a build meeting on 8 October 2026, after watching recorded performances of key scenes was discussed, one participant said that in a course this centred on knowledge, bringing in other elements of knowledge makes sense, asked where to draw the line, and suggested putting a stake in the ground: maybe 30% or 40% of the content knowledge building relying on multiple media, with other parts purely reading (`g9/sources/meeting-notes/Incept Service CoE Catchup - 2026_10_08 10_30 CEST - Notes by Gemini.md`, lines 434-464). Nothing on record fixes the share.
